mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, contact, phone, address, is_active FROM supplier WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY supplier_name

SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, contact, phone, address, is_active FROM supplier
(supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND is_active = #{searchActive}
ORDER BY supplier_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier (supplier_name, contact, phone, address, is_active) VALUES (#{supplierName}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier SET supplier_name = #{supplierName}, contact = #{contact}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
UPDATE supplier SET is_active = 0 WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: SELECT '결재문서' AS tradeType, d.doc_type AS docType, d.doc_no AS docNo, d.title AS title, d.status AS status, CASE d.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '기안중' WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '결재완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '반려' ELSE d.status END AS statusLabel, DATE_FORMAT(d.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS tradeDate, m.name AS requesterName, d.doc_id AS refId FROM approval_doc d LEFT JOIN member m ON d.requester_id = m.member_id WHERE d.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND d.doc_type = 'INBOUND' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_doc WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND doc_type = 'INBOUND'
